mutants.what: the unmutated library, built through the same path patch as the mutants
the unused amount reported by the receiver is no longer capped by the transferred amount
an unparsable, failed or too long receiver result counts as fully used instead of fully refunded
the refund is credited to the sender without debiting the receiver
the storage minimum is measured one byte short
mutants.why_outside: changes only how much NEAR a registration costs; no monitor reads NEAR balances

mutants.what: the settlement callback gets 3 Tgas instead of 5
mutants.why_outside: changes only the gas attached to the callback, which still completes in the simulator; no monitor reads gas

mutants.what: a withdrawal larger than the balance empties the account instead of being refused, while the receiver is credited in full
a forced unregistration removes the balance but leaves it in the total supply
storage_unregister without the force argument burns a positive balance
storage_deposit refunds the excess NEAR to the registered account instead of the payer
mutants.why_outside: changes only who receives a NEAR refund; no monitor reads NEAR balances

fixtures.what: the reference token with two added methods: an init that only the parent (factory) account may call and that creates no tokens, and a mint that only the factory may call
the reference token with ft_transfer_call made to fail always; nothing it does is wrong, but half of the monitors have nothing to judge
